description: This file is a startup script for a Node.js-based web development environment, responsible for configuring environment variables and launching either a static build/serve process in CI or a development server locally. It handles environment detection, process spawning, and environment variable management specific to the project’s startup process.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is a Continuous Integration environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously with specified arguments and exits the process with the command's status code.
